initial.name: 01-looking-through
initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make one new Moon Signal app illustration of the SAME awake female D2 calico cat in the reference, now physically HOLDING A TELESCOPE with her front paws. Match the reference cat's identity: elegant slender feline proportions, mostly smoky charcoal face and forehead, small warm cream muzzle and chest, pointed triangular ears, expressive modest amber eyes, long curling tail, broad muted biscuit-tan calico patches. Tan is desaturated #BB8D5C / #BE9264, NOT vivid orange. Warm charcoal #1D171B background, smoky fur #40363A, cream #C7BBA4, taupe #A39480. Same simple editorial illustration style with broad clean color shapes, restrained shading, delicate sparse feathered fur tips along cheek, ears, back and tail, very thin low contrast outlines. Slight warm edge light, not a continuous heavy glowing border. A large pale buttery ivory full moon with a soft diffuse amber halo sits BEHIND the cat as in reference. Single centered square composition, full cat including tail and feet visible, generous negative space. Telescope is a simplified compact cream-and-charcoal optical telescope with muted tan/brass collars that matches the separate telescope in reference. Physically plausible hand positions with at most two front paws, no extra limbs; small eyepiece at cat's eye, wider objective facing outward when looking through it. Friendly curious attentive expression, not a grinning mascot. No clothes, props beyond telescope, stars, scenery, labels, text, UI, borders, photorealistic fur, grain or highly rendered 3D. Pose A: Seated in a clear three-quarter side view, looking through a small handheld telescope pointed diagonally up to the right, both front paws holding it—one near eyepiece, one supporting the barrel below. One eye to eyepiece, the other gently narrowed. Tail curves along ground to left. No tripod. Telescope modest size so cat remains the main subject.

refinements.name: 01-looking-through
refinements.prompt: Precisely refine this illustration. Preserve same cat, same pose/composition, moon, background and telescope style. Correct feline anatomy: there must be exactly FOUR legs total. Both front legs are raised holding the telescope. Remove the extra slender vertical front leg and its extra white paw on the ground at center of the seated cat. Only TWO hind paws may touch the ground, one attached to each folded haunch, with charcoal/cream belly between; no third ground paw, no fifth leg. Keep both raised front paws naturally connected to their shoulders.  Keep her face mostly charcoal: any orange forehead patch becomes smoky charcoal, retain cream muzzle. Tone golden/orange fur down to muted biscuit tan #BB8D5C matching D2 awake reference. Preserve the gentle feathered edge texture, pointed ears, moon halo and flat editorial rendering. No other changes, no text.
